content: Geranylgeranyl pyrophosphate synthase is an enzyme encoded by the GGPS1 gene in humans. This gene belongs to the prenyltransferase family and produces a protein that exhibits geranylgeranyl diphosphate (GGPP) synthase activity. The enzyme facilitates the synthesis of GGPP by catalyzing a reaction between farnesyl diphosphate and isopentenyl diphosphate. GGPP plays a critical role in the C20-prenylation of proteins, a post-translational modification essential for the proper function of certain proteins. Additionally, GGPP is involved in the regulation of a nuclear hormone receptor. Alternative transcriptional splice variants of the GGPS1 gene have been identified, resulting in the production of different isoforms of the enzyme. Similar to its homolog, farnesyl diphosphate synthase, the activity of GGPS1 is inhibited by bisphosphonate compounds, which are often used in clinical settings to treat bone-related disorders.
